canDoYue: 你識講對花生敏感、唔食豬肉、蛋冇問題、炒飯有花生油、改素麵、分開鑊，同埋叫店員喺張單寫低。
canDoEn: Say you are allergic to peanuts, egg is fine, the fried rice has peanut oil, the noodles are vegetarian from a separate pan, and a note goes on the order.

dialogue.speaker: ana
dialogue.text: I'm allergic to peanuts, and I don't eat pork tonight with the dinner I ordered.
dialogue.glossYue: 你好，我對花生敏感，今晚我唔食豬肉。
dialogue.say: I'm allergic to peanuts, and I don't eat pork tonight with the dinner I ordered.

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: Okay then. Is egg a problem too when this dish also has peanuts in it?
dialogue.glossYue: 好。呢碟都有花生，蛋係咪都有問題？
dialogue.say: Okay then. Is egg a problem too when this dish also has peanuts in it?

dialogue.speaker: ana
dialogue.text: No, egg is fine. Does the hot fried rice now have any peanuts in it?
dialogue.glossYue: 蛋冇問題。熱炒飯入面有冇花生？
dialogue.say: No, egg is fine. Does the hot fried rice now have any peanuts in it?

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: Yes, it has peanut oil. I'd suggest the vegetarian noodles instead of that fried rice.
dialogue.glossYue: 有，飯有花生油。我建議改素麵，唔好食炒飯。
dialogue.say: Yes, it has peanut oil. I'd suggest the vegetarian noodles instead of that fried rice.

dialogue.speaker: ana
dialogue.text: Do those hot vegetarian noodles have any pork in them, or are they fully vegetarian?
dialogue.glossYue: 熱素麵有冇豬肉，定係完全素？
dialogue.say: Do those hot vegetarian noodles have any pork in them, or are they fully vegetarian?

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: No, they're fully vegetarian. I'll ask the kitchen staff to use one separate clean pan.
dialogue.glossYue: 完全素。我會叫廚房用一個乾淨嘅分開鑊。
dialogue.say: No, they're fully vegetarian. I'll ask the kitchen staff to use one separate clean pan.

dialogue.speaker: ana
dialogue.text: Thank you. Please tell the kitchen chef it's a serious peanut allergy before they cook.
dialogue.glossYue: 多謝。請同廚房主廚講，我對花生嚴重敏感。
dialogue.say: Thank you. Please tell the kitchen chef it's a serious peanut allergy before they cook.

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: I will. I'll put a note on your order slip now before the cooking starts.
dialogue.glossYue: 我會。廚房開始之前，我會喺你張單上面寫低。
dialogue.say: I will. I'll put a note on your order slip now before the cooking starts.
